# 获取关键词列表

请求接口： [https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/unit/bid_weight/create](https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/unit/bid_weight/create)

请求方式：POST

数据格式：JSON

### 请求参数

|字段|类型|是否必填|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|--|
|advertiser_id|Long|必填|广告主账号ID||
|scope|Long|必填|添加范围|1 - 账户维度，2 - 广告组维度|
|bid_weight_info|Object[]|必填|优词信息||


|bid_weight_info|类型|是否必填|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|--|
|unit_id|Long|非必填|广告组ID||
|info|Object[]|必填|词信息||


|info|类型|是否必填|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|--|
|weight|Double|必填|提量系数|1.1 ～ 2 保留1位小数|
|word|String|必填|关键词||


### 返回参数

|字段|类型|说明|备注|
|--|--|--|--|
|code|Integer|返回状态码||
|message|String|返回状态信息||
|data|Object|无返回值||

### 请求样例

```json
{
    "advertiser_id": 139494,
    "scope": 2,
    "bid_weight_info": [
        {
            "unit_id": 3891211196,
            "info": [
                {
                    "word": "yiulld04",
                    "weight": 1.1
                },
              	{
                    "word": "yiulld05",
                    "weight": 1.1
                }
            ]
        }
    ],
  	"bid_weight_info": [
        {
          	"unit_id": 3891211197,
          	"info": [
              	{
                	"word": "yiulld04",
                	"weight": 1.1
              	}
            ]
        }
    ]
}
```

### 返回样例

```json
{
    "code": 0,
    "data": "",
    "message": "OK",
    "request_id": "EL2BgIDw9pmaChi8ECDb8cSS4zEoxtXzpQg="
}
```
